title: Effective machine coding scheme
statement: An effective machine coding scheme consists of a machine coding scheme, a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, a natural-valued time-bound function on natural-number inputs, and the property that this machine computes the serialization of the decoded input within that time bound on every input.
hypotheses_covered: a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
a time-bound function from natural numbers to natural numbers
the machine computes the serialization of the decoded input within the stated time bound
caveat: The supplied definitions do not specify the formal meaning of computing a function within a time bound, so the exact input-output and running-time convention is unavailable.
